Click the picture to stamp a splat; drag to paint a stroke. Scene repaints the picture, Clear gives a white pad. The readout shows the last coordinate the DOM delivered.

Canvas 2D has no drawing primitives here (Lane D), so paint.js rasterises everything — scene, splats, strokes — into one ImageData buffer; every mouse event carries pageX/pageY.
